items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Verdine. They used to… …Maurice was pulling out all the sessions. He used to do a lot of the Chess sessions. So he used to do a lot of stuff. He came from the South, I think from Memphis or… …was he from Memphis? One of the cities down South, I forgot where it was. He came up and he used to play really good jazz drums and funk drums and eventually worked with Ramsey, but he was in one of my trios.
Can we talk about what he was like back when he was that young? Was he already spiritually...
